blocks.text: SALT LAKE CITY — Jazz forward Jaren Jackson Jr. will be sidelined for at least six weeks after tearing the MCL in his right knee during the second quarter of Utah’s 110-105 loss to the Memphis Grizzlies. Lauri Markkanen, who sprained his right wrist in the first quarter of the same game on Monday night, is listed as day-to-day. Jackson and Markkanen were two of the top three scorers for the Jazz in the team’s first three games.
